data.title: Story Bridge
data.description: Compare characters, settings, events, and big ideas across two illustrated stories.

stories.title: Sharing at the Park
stories.opening: Lily and Sam went to the park on a warm spring morning.
stories.closing: They played together happily until it was time to go home.
stories.mainIdea: Friends can share toys to have more fun together.

characters.name: Lily
characters.sentence: Lily shared her red toy car with her friend.

characters.name: Sam
characters.sentence: Sam waited patiently for his turn on the slide.

characters.name: Max
characters.sentence: Max kicked the soccer ball to the other children.

stories.title: Sharing at the Beach
stories.opening: Mia and Leo went to the beach on a hot summer afternoon.
stories.closing: They built a huge sandcastle together until the sun went down.
stories.mainIdea: Friends can share tools to build cool things.

characters.name: Mia
characters.sentence: Mia shared her yellow bucket with her friend.

characters.name: Leo
characters.sentence: Leo waited patiently for his turn to fill the bucket.

characters.name: Zoe
characters.sentence: Zoe gave a pretty seashell to her friend.

challenges.comparisonSummary: One story happens at a park and the other story happens at a beach.
